title: Security claims gated pricing and onboarding flow
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise contracts and procurement teams expect concrete security evidence during negotiations, but full SIG/CAIQ responses are time-consuming and increase sales friction. Objective: Create a gated pricing and onboarding experience where customers can advance through negotiated pricing tiers by providing progressively stronger security claims (e.g., self-declaration, signed claim token, or audited evidence extract). This ticket scopes an MVP experiment: a three-tier evidence path (Lite, Verified, Contract-Ready) tied to price/commitment bands and an embedded onboarding flow that minimizes manual effort for both sales and SEs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Flow prototype in Console linking pricing tiers to evidence lanes (Lite, Verified, Contract-Ready). 2) Auto-suggest answers and CAIQ mapping implemented for top 35 frequent questions. 3) Backend endpoint to accept signed claim tokens and store evidence references in customer profile. 4) Sales SE playbook + doc links created. 5) Run A/B experiment with 30 enterprise signups over 6 weeks measuring conversion and negotiation cycle time.
metrics: Primary: reduction in average days-to-contract (baseline target: -20%). Secondary: % of deals qualifying for Verified tier, average deal ACV uplift for Verified vs Lite, NPS for onboarding. Instrumentation: track funnel events (evidence-submitted, evidence-verified, contract-sent, deal-closed) and correlate with pricing tier selected.
